Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

Plot/trial scenes carry SceneSemantics, but FigureSvg renders only page.title and has no figure/per-panel desc composition or diagram-scene coverage. semanticId is still lossy because unsupported characters all map to '-'.

Evidence:
- studio/viz/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/viz/plot/PlotKit.scala:503-507 creates scene semantics
- studio/viz/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/viz/figure/FigureSvg.scala:80-86 calls renderer with only Some(page.title)
- studio/viz/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/viz/plot/SceneSummaries.scala:34 maps every unsupported character to '-'

Remaining / next action: Make semantic IDs injective, aggregate figure/panel title/desc/summary into SVG, re-record goldens, and cover geometry/reference diagrams.

Disposition: Keep open.
